# Matrox Resources Limited

> Matrox Resources Limited is a Lusaka consultancy providing water and sanitation assessments, field research, and technical advisory in Zambia.

## Company

- [About Matrox](/about-us/): Company overview, mission and working values.
- [Services](/services/): Water and sanitation, utility performance, stakeholder research and technical advisory.
- [Our Experience](/our-experience/): Selected water utility and community research assignments.
- [Contact](/contact-us/): Lusaka office and enquiry form.
- [Company profile (PDF)](/downloads/matrox-company-profile.pdf): Download the company profile.
